# Three.js for Director

Pinned npm package: `three@0.186.0` (MIT; see LICENSE.txt).

Only the WebGL module/core and OrbitControls, TransformControls, GLTFLoader, GLTFExporter, BufferGeometryUtils and SkeletonUtils addons are bundled. Original package files are unmodified. Director's import map resolves their imports locally; no CDN request is needed at runtime.

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r186
